description.value: Penticton Memorial Arena is a community sports facility and heritage-listed building in Penticton, BC, historically home to ice hockey and lacrosse. Its inclusion on the City of Penticton Heritage Registry reflects its significance as a civic landmark in the South Okanagan. Touring cyclists passing through Penticton may recognize it as a local landmark, though it functions primarily as a spectator and participant sports venue.
